dataset_name: NASA Mars 2020 MEDA Calibrated Atmospheric Dataset
archival_node: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) Atmospheres Node

sensors_suite.PS: Pressure Sensor (Solid-state piezoresistive barometric transducer, range 0-1150 Pa, precision 3 Pa)
sensors_suite.ATS: Air Temperature Sensors (5 platinum resistance thermometers mounted at 0.84m, 1.45m, and 1.5m)
sensors_suite.TIRS: Thermal Infrared Sensor (Measures surface brightness temperature and downward atmospheric IR radiation)
sensors_suite.WS: Wind Sensor (2 articulated booms measuring 2D/3D wind velocity vector and direction)
sensors_suite.RDS: Radiation and Dust Sensor (8 photodiodes measuring direct and diffuse solar irradiance and dust tau)
sensors_suite.HS: Relative Humidity Sensor (Capacitive transducer measuring atmospheric water vapor saturation percentage)

citation: Rodriguez-Manfredi et al., The Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer (MEDA) Instrument Suite, Space Sci Rev, 217:77 (2021).
